description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This are the Drivers Side and Passengers Side Seat Belt COVERS.
These Covers go inside the Seat Belt Assembly Cavity and cover the backside of the Seat Belt.
Prevents Dirt and Obstructions from contacting Seat Belt
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cover, RH Seatbelt
Qty 1 – Cover, LH Seatbelt
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
